name: JK to Inkou Kyoushi 2 ~Chikan Densha Hen~
original_name: JKと淫行教師2～痴漢電車編～
source:
When the main character is in a crowded train, a girl in front of him suddenly turns around and says, "Don't touch my body!!!" "No, I didn't do it!" He explains to a station attendant about what happened and he is proved to be innocent. However, his anger never disappears....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
当主角在拥挤的火车上时，他面前的一个女孩突然转身说：“不要碰我的身体！！！” “不，我没有这么做！”他向车站工作人员解释了发生的事情，结果证明他是无辜的。然而，他的愤怒却始终没有消失……

[来自工口游戏商店]
